learnings: The orchestration layer should distinguish between a model's 'inconclusive' security finding and an 'inconclusive' result caused by tool/API errors. If an API error occurs, the system should either retry the request or rely on a secondary model's coverage of those files rather than failing the entire audit.
When multiple models are used, coverage gaps in one model can be safely resolved if another model successfully reviewed the missing files, avoiding unnecessary full re-audits.
